description: This file defines the NotesService class in an Angular frontend application. The class provides methods for CRUD operations on notes via HTTP requests to a backend API, utilizing environment configuration for the base URL.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Angular service providing CRUD API calls for notes, including fetching all notes, retrieving individual notes, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the backend API as an Observable array.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and/or content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note specified by ID.
